nodes.label: Encyclopedia Sync Ledger for an Artifact Outside the Repo
nodes.description: The Editorial Pipeline Encyclopedia is a Claude Artifact, not a repo file, so no check in this repository can read or diff its content against docs/. This ledger tracks, per entry, which files/sections/decisions it depends on and the commit it was last verified against — the same shape as .graphify/branch.json's lastAnalyzedHead, applied to something no tool here can actually inspect. The habit it establishes: when closing a decision whose Tier applicability table touches a cited file, note whether an encyclopedia entry is affected, riding the D-54 propagation habit already running on every decision rather than adding a new process.
nodes.rationale: Staleness that can't be mechanically checked still needs to be visible, or it silently accumulates the same way six documents drifted from S1's actual completion before B-061 caught it. A ledger that names its own last-verified commit turns an unenforceable sync problem into a queue a reader can act on, rather than a fact nobody can check.
